waiver: picorv32.v defines eight modules and the CPU is one of them: decode, execute, the ALU and control are all inline in the picorv32 module, so no SYNTH_KEEP_MODULES list can attribute them. This design therefore cannot meet the coverage floor, and the shortfall is a property of the RTL rather than of the method. The register file is the exception: it is an inline array in the RTL, but AUTO_MEMORIES infers it as a 32x32 two-read one-write memory named cpuregs and generates a macro for it, so it is attributable as an instance rather than as a kept module. Upstream also offers a PICORV32_REGS macro that would break it out as a module, but it is commented out by default and using it would measure a different design from the one its author ships.
